collection.title: Citroen DS3 Hatchback 2010 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a 2010 - 2015 Citroen DS3 Hatchback model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have rear blade available, please click on the Rear Blades tab below.
